title: Pulling Your Foot Out of Quicksand Takes a Car's Force

scenes.text: Escaping quicksand takes the force of lifting a car.
Physicists tested real quicksand and found you can't sink all the way under.
Quicksand is about twice as dense as your body, so you float, sinking only to the waist.
The trap is getting out. Freeing one foot takes about the force to lift a medium-sized car.
That's why the real danger is being stuck when the tide comes in.
You won't sink. You'll just need a car's worth of force.

description:
Escaping quicksand takes about the force needed to lift a medium-sized car.
Physicists found it is twice as dense as a person, so you can't sink all the way under. The danger is getting stuck.
